name: Agent Code Guard
description: Blocks named agents from directly writing/editing code or config, pushing them to delegate instead.

agentIds.description: Agent ids this guard applies to. Empty array = applies to no agent (guard is a no-op until configured).

delegateTo.description: Names shown in the block message, e.g. the coding agents the guarded agent should delegate to.

blockedExtensionsDirect.description: File extensions (no dot) blocked for edit/write/apply_patch. Default: py, js, ts, jsx, tsx, json, sh.

blockedExtensionsExec.description: File extensions (no dot) blocked when detected inside exec commands (heredocs, cp/mv, cat redirects). Default: py, js, ts, jsx, tsx, sh.

exceptedPaths.description: Regex patterns (matched against the symlink-resolved real path and its basename) that are always allowed even if they hit a blocked extension - e.g. status/changelog files the guarded agent is allowed to keep updating itself. Matched against the resolved path, so aliasing an excepted name to a protected file via a symlink does not bypass protection.

blockedPaths.description: Regex patterns (matched against the raw path, the symlink-resolved real path, and its basename) that are always blocked, with no exceptedPaths override. Default: empty.

mode.description: 'block' silently and immediately denies the tool call. 'requireApproval' shows an operator approval prompt instead. 'audit' never blocks or prompts - it only logs what would have been blocked, at warn level.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: Only used in requireApproval mode: how long to wait for an operator decision before applying approvalTimeoutBehavior.

approvalTimeoutBehavior.description: Only used in requireApproval mode: what happens if the approval prompt times out.
